messages:
Alex: Minor but important: the API ref for POST /v1/generate currently documents the response shape as returning an array 'outputs' with objects having 'text' + 'score'. Our SDK snippets (Java + Python) and the example responses show 'choices' with 'delta' fields. CI lint flagged examples != schema. Can someone take a quick look?

Priya: I noticed that too. The backend actually returns 'choices' (array) and each choice has 'delta' fragments when streaming, then a 'text' on final. The API ref page was an old schema leftover.

Mateo: TL;DR: we should update the API ref schema to 'choices' to match runtime, and add a small paragraph explaining streaming vs non-streaming response shapes. Also update the example response blocks.

Jin: Agree. Two small cautions:
1) The openapi yaml is used by our SDK generator; if we change the top-level response schema shape, we need to re-run the SDK generator and bump the example snippets.
2) The Java snippet currently deserializes into Outputs[] which will break if we change shape without updating code.

Lindsey: Proposed action list: 
- Update api-reference/generate.md schema from 'outputs'->'choices'
- Add a "Streaming responses" subsection with a concrete SSE example showing "event: chunk" and final "event: done" payloads
- Regenerate SDK snippets (python/node/java) from updated openapi and paste into examples/snippets
- Add "Compatibility" one-liner and Migration note with sample mapping: outputs[] -> choices[]; text->delta + final text merge

Priya: I'll open branch docs/choices-response-sync and submit a PR. I'll do the content changes and leave SDK regeneration to Mateo (he owns the snippet generator).

Mateo: I can regen snippets. FYI the generator requires openapi v3 schema strictness; I hit a validator issue last time where 'additionalProperties: false' tripped on our example metadata. I'll pin the generator to v0.9.2 in the repo for consistency.

Alex: Good call. Please also update the example curl to include Content-Type: application/json and a minimal header example. Some customers hit unclear errors when the header was omitted.

Priya: Draft streaming example (will refine in PR):
```
# SSE curl example
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"Write a haiku about moons","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# server sends: 
event: chunk
data: {"delta":"Soft silver light"}
event: chunk
data: {"delta":"on the sleeping ocean"}
event: done
data: {"id":"resp_abc","status":"complete"}
```

Jin: I'll update the openapi and run the generator locally, then push the updated snippets to the PR branch.

Docs-bot: linked issue #2134 -> PR 5178 opened by Priya with label 'docs:needs-review'

Priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5178  changes: api-reference/generate.md + examples/snippets + /docs/compatibility.md note. Reviewers: @alex, @mateo, @lindsey. ETA tomorrow noon.

Alex: Thanks. Quick reviewer checklist: ensure examples compile in python and java, verify openapi passes 'make docs-validate', and add the one-line compatibility blurb at top of page. I'll review tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
